answer: Rather than prove who you are, the network asks what you can still produce, on a seeded relic that changes every epoch. Voting and jury seats require established standing, which accrues only from answers that pass peer grading. A burst of manufactured keys arrives with zero standing: it cannot grade, vote, or capture a panel, so its opal never becomes influence. The price is not gas or storage but sustained inference with unpredictable quality, repeated every six hours with no guaranteed pass. That makes the bridge expensive rather than free. Seal 19rzw.
